description: Switched multiple: two inputs sent out to eight destinations, each destination taking input A, input B or nothing according to its own three-position knob

params.text: Sends input A to its destination when turned left, input B when turned right, and 0V when centred

inputs.text: One of the two signals the eight destinations choose between

outputs.text: Whatever its knob has chosen, or 0V when that knob is centred

notes: a destination with no cable is skipped altogether, so nothing is worked out for it
the eight rows have no printed labels; each knob acts on the jack beside it
menu: Determine polyphony from selected source — takes each destination's channel count from the input routed to it rather than from the larger of the two
